summary: Backend + frontend testing for the multilingual Trusted Conclusion pipeline. 11/11 backend tests pass (providers/plans/me regression, answer_language accepted on POST /api/queries, Trusted Conclusion synthesised in target language for IT/EN/FR, GET /api/conclusions/{id}?lang=es translates on demand with cache_hit=true on repeat and correct output for a 3rd different lang, thresholds.jaccard_fallback == 0.70, no self-match after POST /api/queries, only OpenAI+Gemini panellists, exactly 2 responses). Frontend: Home page fully localised in Italian, language switcher persists via localStorage (referee_interface_lang=it) across reloads, submitted Italian question routed through smart-reuse to Reused Results page where trusted-conclusion-body has data-answer-language="it" and body renders in Italian. Localised labels present: 'Conclusione Affidabile', 'Sfida la conclusione', 'Perché questa conclusione', 'Consenso Riutilizzato', 'Affidabilità', 'Livello di consenso', 'Attendibilità'.

issues: Reuse-explanation banner text 'This Trusted Conclusion was served instantly from Referee's consensus cache. No new AI comparison was run. · Previous question:' remains in English even when interface language is IT.
Per-model expand toggle 'Show arguments, strengths & weaknesses' remains in English on the individual panel cards while the rest of the page is Italian.

action_items: Localise the reused-mode explanation banner on Results (currently hardcoded English string starting with 'This Trusted Conclusion was served instantly from ...').
Localise the per-model card 'Show arguments, strengths & weaknesses' toggle label.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 875 lines — nearing the 700-line split threshold; consider factoring queries/compare/conclusions routers into separate modules.
_translate_or_fetch is well-structured with clear cache tiers (translations sub-doc > legacy translation_cache > synth) — good.
SUPPORTED set correctly includes {en,it,es,fr,de,pt}; SYNTH_MODEL and TRANSLATE_MODEL both pinned to gpt-5.4-mini as spec requires.
compare_query correctly UPSERTs the conclusions row only after synthesis, using $setOnInsert to avoid overwriting create metadata.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core multilingual flows pass; 2 minor untranslated strings on reused Results page)

seed_data_creation: Test-only public IT/EN/FR/ES conclusions were created via the compare endpoint using unique prompt suffixes to avoid cache pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend synthesis + on-demand translation caching verified end-to-end. Frontend IT locale coverage on Home and Results (fresh + reused) verified. Two remaining hardcoded English strings on Results page reused-mode banner and per-model expand toggle — main agent can add these keys to locales and update the components. Anonymous compare still returns exactly 2 responses (OpenAI + Google DeepMind labels), no Anthropic/xAI/Mistral leakage. SMART_REUSE_THRESHOLD verified at 0.70.
